# BigQuery observations for geography_angle

SELECT ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0))
=> "1.5707963267948966"

SELECT ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90), ST_GEOGPOINT(90, 0))
=> "4.71238898038469"

SELECT ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(8.9e-12, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> null

SELECT ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 20), ST_GEOGPOINT(-170, -20), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "1.0947897205739903"

SELECT ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> error: ST_Angle: Argument to STAngle must be a single point geography; an argument was the empty geography.

SELECT ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'))
=> error: ST_Angle: Argument to STAngle must be a single point geography; an argument contained a line.

SELECT ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 1 1)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0))
=> error: ST_Angle: Argument to STAngle must be a single point geography; an argument had 2 points.

# BigQuery geography function documentation.

SELECT ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> "4.71238898038469"

SELECT ROUND(ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1)), 12)
=> "0.785474321619"

SELECT CAST(ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0)) AS INT64)
=> "0"

SELECT ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(-30, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(150, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_ANGLE(NULL, ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_ANGLE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1))
=> null
